name: Razer Tartarus via RP2040 converter (RadPad VIA)

content.label: Slow scroll, ms between wheel steps (x5)
Slower scroll with thumb held (x5 ms)
Fast scroll, ms between wheel steps (x5)
Faster scroll with thumb held (x5 ms)

customKeycodes.name: Dictate
customKeycodes.title: Ctrl+F21 for tartarus.ahk (activates PowerScribe, sends F4); toggles the red dictate LEDs

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Up Slow
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll up at the Slow speed until pressed again. Speed is set in Lighting > Scroll speed. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the Slower speed instead.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Down Slow
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll down at the Slow speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the Slower speed instead.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Up Fast
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll up at the Fast speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the Faster speed instead.

customKeycodes.name: Scroll Down Fast
customKeycodes.title: Toggle: scroll down at the Fast speed until pressed again. Holding the thumb key when you press it uses the Faster speed instead.

customKeycodes.title: Next idle LED effect

customKeycodes.name: LED FX Prev
